purpose: An always-available deterministic help hub with search, glossary, guided help, release notes, privacy-safe diagnostics, dashboard presets, canonical navigation and separately gated AI assistance.
primaryGoal: Find trustworthy explanations and next actions without requiring AI, and review exactly what support diagnostics will contain before sharing them.

dataSources.name: Deterministic help index
dataSources.behavior: Builds static index from routeRegistry, helpGlossary, emptyStateGuidance, onboardingTasks and dataUnavailability; fixed scoring, stable id tie-breaks, default 12 search results and six route suggestions. No network or model.
dataSources.limits: Registry consumers/imports inspected, but the imported registries other than glossary were not individually audited. Search scores English fallback titles/terms, not translated labels.

dataSources.name: Glossary
dataSources.behavior: Seven definitions retain term, definition, measurement provenance, aliases and optional context route; always visible independently of contextual-help preference.

dataSources.name: Release notes
dataSources.behavior: Uses generated changelog; three releases by default and five action-first summary items per release. Audience/action/migration inference is deliberately conservative. Uses existing formatDate.
dataSources.limits: Generated changelog and date-format internals not inspected; no claim of complete changelog coverage or date/time runtime correctness.

dataSources.name: Support bundle
dataSources.behavior: Browser-only explicit redacted projection; source unknown stays unknown. Health accepts 503 response bodies and continues standard polling. Version/health read hooks forward signal. Bundle includes coarse browser capability, online flag, viewport bucket, reduced-motion, redacted recent error digests and demo marker. JSON preview matches copy/download serialization.
dataSources.limits: No backend response or privacy runtime test executed; support input projection inspected but privacy helper internals not audited.

dataSources.name: Problem report
dataSources.behavior: User-opened modal only; title/description validation, per-submission diagnostics consent false by default, normalized route template, exact preview/copy, pending-submit guards, inline failure and mutation toast. Existing feedback route is reused; audit did not invoke it.

dataSources.name: Dashboard presets
dataSources.behavior: Four roles with eight widget IDs each. Help panel preserves selected/applied/pending distinctions, toggle-to-clear and explicit reapply after divergence. Listens to storage, preset-applied event and visibilitychange; dashboard owns actual adoption.
dataSources.limits: Only first 180 lines of preset registry read; underlying persistence and dashboard write path not fully traced, and no selection or reapply action executed.

dataSources.name: AI assistance and eligibility
dataSources.behavior: Fail-closed rag-help gate; off mode emits no AI wrapper. Explicit ask uses trimmed prompt, canonical stream and shared output/evidence renderer, without affecting deterministic siblings.
dataSources.limits: Stream implementation read through line 240 only; cancellation/parser remainder, backend retrieval/citations and authentication behavior are unverified. Settings read adapter inspected; no endpoint invoked.

dataSources.name: Guided help
dataSources.behavior: Opt-in product intro and tour-launcher dispatch, never auto-opened. Wizard close marks onboarding completed and broadcasts completion; preserve this existing side effect.

components.name: GlassPanel
components.contract: Neutral shared panel surface, print marker, forced-colors and hover; glow='cyan' means hover border tint, not literal bloom.

components.contract: Use role wrappers and as overrides rather than arbitrary per-page text scale.

components.name: Input / Textarea / Button / CopyButton / Badge / Modal
components.contract: Retain native names, labels, focus, loading/disabled semantics and copy/modal behavior; internals not individually inspected.

components.name: IconBox
components.contract: Color/size map, fallback guard; toned foreground with existing neon-named translucent chip tokens, no shadow class applied by IconBox.

components.name: FadeIn
components.contract: Preference hook, reduced-motion initial=false, bounded delay and duration; eight page wrappers retained.

components.name: HelpLinkCard and six help-index panels
components.contract: Local stable links, deterministic search, glossary, guided entry, release summaries, diagnostics and presets; do not replace with fixtures.

components.name: AIRAGHelp / AIFeatureCard / AiOutputPanel
components.contract: withAiFeature gating, inputSlot, canStart, stream lifecycle, result and evidence display.

components.contract: Lazy open-state mount; consent/report submission and guided introduction must survive. Wizard uses useDialogFocus but custom overlay chrome.

issues.detail: Preset grid minmax(17rem,1fr) lacks the min(100%,17rem) clamp used by the curated-link grid. With shell/panel/card gutters, a 320px container can allocate less than 272px and the track cannot shrink.
issues.fix: Use the existing allocated-width-safe grid pattern or accepted CardGrid adapter, keeping all four cards and all widgets/actions.

positiveEvidence.detail: Labeled combobox, controls/active-descendant, listbox/option, result live region and arrow/Enter navigation.
Whole-card native Link and explicit focus-visible ring; decorative icons hidden.
Shared useDialogFocus plus dialog name/description; runtime trap/restoration not verified.

issues.detail: onKeyDown returns whenever results are empty before handling Escape; a zero-result search therefore cannot use the documented Escape-to-clear behavior.
issues.fix: Process Escape before the results guard; keep result wrapping, Enter navigation, active-descendant and deterministic ranking unchanged.

issues.detail: Context links use inline text-xs with no explicit target padding/min-height or focus-visible treatment at this call site; similarly dashboard link at DashboardPresetPanel.tsx:123. Actual computed target size/focus may be supplied globally and is not measured.
issues.fix: Compose existing native-link/button-link treatment with documented target spacing/focus while retaining all hrefs and descriptions; verify effective target reachability rather than replacing links with click-only elements.

states.static: Welcome, channels, index, glossary, guided actions, release summaries, presets and curated links are not gated by network/AI data.
states.loading: Support actions disable while version/health initially load; SystemSummaryBrief receives loading. AI shared card renders streaming label/output state. Static sources need no invented skeleton.
states.empty: HelpSearch has translated no-match message; ReleaseNotesPanel has translated empty message; AiOutputPanel has completed-no-output message.
states.error: Problem report retains form and inline error; support source errors are not surfaced; AI failure branch replaces visible result with error.
states.offline: Static index remains local. Support bundle records online flag. No source-specific offline/retry UI is exposed by useSupportBundle.
states.stale: Support hook may retain TanStack cached version/health data but drops source timestamps and refresh errors before presentation.
states.unknown: Bundle projections use unknown for unavailable version/health; this must never become zero or measured health.

issues.detail: useSupportBundle destructures only data/isLoading from version and health, then returns only assembled bundle and loading. SupportBundlePanel.tsx:99 passes available unconditionally. A constructed bundle can exist while upstream health/version fail or retained values are stale, without source-specific error, last-success or retry.
issues.fix: Preserve always-usable redacted bundle and copy/download; extend existing hook result with per-source DataState/retry/freshness and feed accurate source context to SystemSummaryBrief. Distinguish bundle construction availability from live health evidence; do not turn unknown into healthy/zero.

issues.detail: Error branch renders only error even when text is nonempty, hiding accumulated partial output on terminal stream failure. AIRAGHelp uses this shared renderer via AIFeatureCard.
issues.fix: Extend the existing renderer to display usable partial text with explicit partial/error indication alongside recovery. Preserve escaped plain text and privacy-safe evidence trail; do not assert failed output is complete.

visualIssues.detail: Help-launched intro uses custom overlay/card, fixed white-alpha border, blur and cyan bloom; additional glowing progress at line 187, colored icon shadow at line 202 and cyan/purple gradient action at line 235. These remain contrary to the restrained surface contract.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should compose canonical Modal/Button/typography and neutral semantic tokens, retaining all four steps, close/skip/next/final actions, completion broadcast, explicit invocation and focus behavior.

visualIssues.detail: Ad-hoc text-2xs chip styling repeats in ReleaseNotesPanel.tsx:111 and DashboardPresetPanel.tsx:286; additional text-xs summary/pre styling in SupportBundlePanel.tsx:111-116 bypasses typography roles.
visualIssues.fix: Adopt existing Caption/Text/Code/Badge roles while preserving metadata, copyable JSON formatting and semantic markup. Do not create another typography component.

architectureIssues.detail: Preset widget names render widget.labelFallback directly. Other role/audience/rationale strings use t(), but all 32 widget-label occurrences stay English. PresetWidget currently has widgetId and labelFallback but no translation key at dashboardPresets.ts:30-34.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing widget translation ownership or a typed translation-key contract without eagerly importing dashboard widget implementations. Catalog/shared integration owner must preserve stable widget IDs and fallback labels; page owns rendering through t().

architectureIssues.detail: /help is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS and vehicle-disabled sets. getWorkspaceRouteScope therefore yields range=false, vehicle=true although HelpPage and AIRAGHelp consume no selected vehicle and no range. The header vehicle control can imply scope that does not affect this general-help page.
architectureIssues.fix: Workspace integration owner should decide and explicitly document general-help vehicle ownership, normally disable misleading vehicle scope; do not add a local picker or vehicle payload to RAG merely to make an irrelevant control appear functional.
architectureIssues.confidence: high source mismatch; header runtime unverified

architectureIssues.detail: Feature directly imports shared ProblemReportModal module; GuidedHelpPanel.tsx:6 likewise imports OnboardingWizard directly rather than category barrel.
architectureIssues.fix: Use existing feedback category export when it exposes the same implementation; otherwise report an exclusive barrel-owner addition. Preserve lazy open-state mounting and do not introduce wrappers.

architectureIssues.detail: Search ranks titleFallback, summaryFallback and English-derived terms, even though displayed results are localized through t(). Non-English visible labels are not automatically searchable.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared help-index owner should define an explicit locale-aware searchable-text adapter that preserves deterministic ranking, route/id identity, offline operation and English aliases. No AI-backed ranking or competing index.

priority.rationale: Fix narrow-container risk and documented keyboard defect, then preserve source trust/partial results and canonical intro chrome. No wholesale page replacement.

competingImplementations.detail: Existing custom intro overlay/card/buttons competes with canonical Modal/Button presentation; focus already reuses useDialogFocus, so preserve that behavior rather than invent another focus system.
Not a competing surface engine: existing GlassPanel's cyan glow prop is only border tint. Do not falsely report actual glowing Help cards based on the prop name.
Deterministic index and AI help are intentionally complementary, not duplicate implementations to consolidate away.

preservation.sectionCountingRule: Count welcome and channels as separate visible blocks, then index, optional AI, glossary, guided help, release notes, support bundle, presets and curated links. Page comments duplicate number 5; do not use those labels as an accurate count.

sections.name: Ways to get help; three channels

actions: Search typing/arrow navigation/Enter/Escape and option click
Replay intro, close/skip/next/final and browse tours
Copy/download exact redacted support JSON and native details disclosure
Open/cancel/report submit, consent, exact preview/copy and error retry
Choose/clear preset, explicitly reapply diverged preset, open dashboard
Ask AI with nonempty trimmed prompt only when opted in
dataBehavior: Static baseline survives AI-off, unresolved settings and network failures; no all-content data gate.
No vehicle/range-dependent measurement data or new unit conversion is introduced. Prose unit examples are source explanations, not authorization to mutate SI.
Keep existing query keys, retry/stale/polling and cancellation policies.
Unknown version/health remains unknown, never zero/healthy; keep source provenance and partial/stale meanings.
Preserve redaction, route-template normalization, bounded bundle projections, explicit consent and closed attachment policy.
Preserve chosen/applied/queued/diverged dashboard state and do not automatically overwrite customized dashboards.
Preserve public source/explanations, current three-release/five-item summary behavior and translated role/context wording.
Do not reset persisted themes, units, locale, motion or contextual-help preferences.
